prompt.description: What the video shows: scene, camera movement, lighting, mood and audio. Put exclusions in the prompt too (for example 'no dialogue').
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: Image to animate. It becomes the starting frame of the video.
image.title: Image

last_frame.description: Ending frame. Needs image as the starting frame; the video transitions between the two. Durations up to 10 seconds.
last_frame.title: Last Frame

reference_images.description: Up to 6 reference images that keep characters, objects or style consistent (up to 3 images per character for up to 2 characters).
reference_images.title: Reference Images
